failure_summary.description: Follow-up criteria were ignored or applied from a stale base, previously applied criteria were repeated, and transformed results were not saved.

patch.reasoning: The skill already explicitly requires using the latest compatible cached result, applying only new criteria, saving transformations, interpreting preferences in conversation context, and carrying forward requested flight legs and hotel dates. The failures contradict those existing instructions, so additional edits would duplicate guidance rather than address a demonstrated skill gap.
